title: fix(core)!: Change Owner refuses an object of a disabled package with 404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED
body:
Fixes #36261

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `@objectstack/core` gains the root export `objectPackageDisabledError`, and all three Change Owner doors newly answer `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` for an object of a disabled package, which they answered `200` before
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/` teaches Change Owner; the refusal carries the data door's own sentence, which names the fix

## 维护者速读

- 管理员停用某个软件包后，用户再也不能通过“更改负责人”去改这个包里对象的记录负责人，也不会再收到相关通知；之前可以改，改完还会发通知。
- 属于“停用软件包”这一组问题的收口：停用的包本应停止服务它的全部记录，数据接口早已拒绝，更改负责人这道门之前漏了。
- 有转移权限的用户在停用包的对象上点更改负责人，会收到“包已停用”的提示，记录及其关联子记录都不变，可选的关联列表也不再列出；重新启用包即恢复，可直接撤回本改动。
- 无

## BREAKING

For a caller that changes owners on a disabled package's object:

- FROM: `POST /api/v1/data/:object/:id/change-owner` and `POST /api/v1/data/:object/change-owner` answered `200` for an object of a disabled package. The owner changed, a named cascade moved its child rows, and the notification was sent. `GET /api/v1/data/:object/change-owner/cascades` answered `200` with the object's cascade candidates.
- TO: all three doors answer `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`, and nothing is read, written or sent. To fix it, re-enable the package.

ADR-0087 disposition (stated in full in the changeset's marker): not-required (no-migration-prescription). No schema key, stored row, registry key or authored value changes. The answer returns to what it was the moment the package is re-enabled.

## What changes

- `packages/core/src/security/change-record-owner.ts`: `offeredDefinition` (shared by `changeRecordOwner` and `changeRecordsOwner`) now asks the engine registry's `isObjectPackageDisabled` right after the object resolves and BEFORE the Change Owner switch is read. An object of a disabled package is refused with the data door's own envelope: `code: 'OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED'`, `status: 404`, `object`. Nothing is looked up, written or emitted. `ChangeOwnerEngine` picks `registry` from `UserWorkEngine`, the in-package precedent (`user-assigned-work.ts` `servedObjects`).
- `packages/core/src/utils/object-package-disabled.ts` (new): the ONE constructor `objectPackageDisabledError`, moved down verbatim from `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (`protocol-authoring-refusals.ts`) because core cannot import metadata-protocol (ADR-0076 D2 boundary). It follows the `objectNotFoundError` / `recordNotFoundError` precedent. `@objectstack/core` exports it, and metadata-protocol re-exports the same function under the same name, so its importers are unchanged. **Producer note:** this file and the metadata-protocol re-export sit outside the claimed surface (`packages/core/src/security/**`, `change-owner-routes.ts`). The only other option was a second copy of the refusal, which the constructor's own docblock forbids.
- `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`: one provenance row, `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` under `@objectstack/core`, beside `CHANGE_OWNER_DISABLED`. `check:error-code-provenance` requires it because the stamp site moved into core. No code is minted, and the union, status and wire shape are unchanged.
- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`: both Change Owner sections, single and bulk, now document the `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` refusal beside `403 CHANGE_OWNER_DISABLED`.
- `.changeset/36261-change-owner-disabled-package.md`: declares the narrowing (the `(narrowing)` arm, `!` headline, BREAKING FROM/TO, `adr-0087` marker), following the same-class siblings 35195, 35427, 35525 and 35526.
- REST, the two write doors: the thrown refusal reaches them through their existing `sendRefusal` → `handleRouteError` classification, which answers `404` with nested `error.code: OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`.
- REST, the third door `GET …/change-owner/cascades` (added on main by #36525): it reads `getSchema` and `changeOwnerOffReason` directly, so the core check did not reach it. `change-owner-routes.ts` now asks the same registry predicate in the same order (after the object resolves, before the switch) and throws the same `objectPackageDisabledError`. A request naming a cascade on the write doors is refused by core's `offeredDefinition` before `cascadeRelationsOf`, any previous-owner read, and any parent or child write.

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/security/change-record-owner.test.ts`, new top-level `describe('[#36261] an object of a disabled package')`:
  - single → 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`; `engine.calls` is empty (no find, no update), `messaging.emit` was not called, and the row is unchanged;
  - bulk → the same;
  - a switched-off object (`pinned_lead`) of a disabled package answers the package refusal, not `CHANGE_OWNER_DISABLED`. This shows the check runs before the switch;
  - control: the same object with its package enabled moves, single and bulk.
- `packages/rest/src/change-owner-routes.test.ts`, new top-level `describe('[#36261] …')`:
  - the single and bulk doors answer `404` with `error.code === 'OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED'`, `engine.update` is not called and `emit` is not called;
  - control: package enabled → 200 for both, and the predicate was asked.

## Acceptance notes

- Ablation (core pin, subject resolved from `src` by relative import, no dist leg needed): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` on the check line. The anchor went 1 → 0 and the blob 37970183af5f → 9993c0ad4202. Three pins went red (single, bulk, before-the-switch; `Tests 3 failed | 23 passed (26)`). The file was restored with blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- Read-only observations, not filed:
  - `packages/services/service-analytics/src/api-exposure-door.ts:202` carries its own copy of `objectPackageDisabledError`. It could now import core's, but that is outside this card.
  - The card's note that `recycle-bin-routes.ts` reaches the engine without a package check was not verified here. It is the same family as the disabled-packages topic.

- rest: the cascades read answers 404 when the package is disabled and lists the candidates when it is enabled; a single POST naming a cascade answers 404 with no parent or child write.

1. `packages/core/src/security/change-record-owner.ts`, the `offeredDefinition` hunk (the order of the check against the switch).
2. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-refusals.ts`, the constructor replaced by a re-export (identity of the data door's refusal).
